skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Octopath Illusion
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Octopath Illusion. Hellagur's clothing during his time as vanguard commander in the Bloodpeak Campaign. If he weren't an enemy, if he could have served Ursus... Even if no such possibility existed.
skins.usage: One of Hellagur's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'I like leading the vanguard in all my battles. In his case, I imagine it'd be the shieldguard.'
